title: Engineering Technical Officer
screening_questions: Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
apply_instructions: Apply on SEEK (advert 95173338); no link out and no applications email published by the employer.
rationale: Advert accepts someone who has or is working towards a Civil Engineering qualification; Marc holds a BSCE and an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design.
Duties include preparing design drawings, plans and calculations for the capital works program, which matches his road, pavement and stormwater design coursework in AutoCAD and Civil 3D.
Site inspections, asset condition checks and reports draw on his site inspections, quality checks and site reports in the Philippines.
caution: Advert says the Town seeks an experienced Engineering Officer; Marc has about one year of site work (2019 to 2020) and no Australian local government experience. Perth relocation needed. Closes 25 October 2026 and the Town interviews before closing.
gaps: No asset management or GIS software on a job
employer_line: The Town of Claremont is the local government for the riverside suburbs of Claremont and Swanbourne in Perth, established in 1898, and ranked number one in the 2023/24 MARKYT Community Scorecard.
